title: Chapter 99
text:
Han Xiao followed the tracks, and all he could see was a boundless desert. The tracks left behind by Luo Qing and the rest were as obvious as the folds on a piece of white paper.

The radar showed their current location so that he would not get lost. They were currently heading towards the outer edge of the Somar Desert. The weather calendar showed that a sandstorm had occurred in this area not long ago.

The monotonous desert scenery made Han Xiao feel tired. After chasing for more than half an hour, an off-road vehicle suddenly appeared in the distance. He was instantly energized. I finally caught up!

The Rose Militant members in the off-road vehicle also noticed Han Xiao.

"It's Thorns!" Su Li exclaimed.

Luo Qing's face tensed up. He quickly looked around and realized that there was only one vehicle chasing after them. He was instantly enraged.

You dare to chase after us alone? Do you think we are easy targets?

"Turn around …"

Boom! Boom!

Thorns fired at full power, and the grenades and missiles chased after Luo Qing.

Luo Qing retracted his head and said awkwardly, "Ahem, let's run for a while and wait for them to finish firing!"

Sparks flew all the way as the two cars chased each other across the sand dunes.

…

The worn-out pilgrims trudged across the sand dunes with difficulty. The leading old pilgrim was panting heavily, and his clothes were drenched in sweat. He untied his water bottle from the back of his horse and gulped down a mouthful of water. However, he could not quench his thirst and fatigue.

The old pilgrim turned around and looked at the group. Everyone looked listless, and the remaining few were the last of the pilgrims. The old pilgrim recalled the time when he was young. Tens of thousands of his compatriots had embarked on this journey. After years of hardship, only twenty of them were left. Some had died, and some had given up.

Sometimes, the old pilgrim could not help but doubt the existence of Felonia. However, if he gave up, he would be denying his many years of perseverance.

The sound of engines could be heard from afar. Han Xiao and the Rose Militant's vehicles appeared in their field of vision.

The pilgrims were not surprised. When they saw that the two vehicles had no intention of crashing into them, they were relieved. They stood still and waited for the two vehicles to leave.

At this time, a small missile missed again and hit a patch of sand. At this time, a sudden change occurred!

The ground suddenly shook. At the place where the missile exploded, the desert caved in, and the quicksand slid down, revealing a black hole. The hole kept expanding, like the mouth of the earth!

The appearance of the quicksand proved that there was a huge hole under the desert!

"What is that?!" The pilgrim looked in the direction of the cave, his mouth wide open.

…

You have discovered the hidden location [Felonia-08]. You have gained 1,000 Exploration EXP.

[Bounty Hunter (Rose Militant)] Hidden requirement met.

"Huh?" Han Xiao almost slipped and overturned the car.

What the hell?!

How could he be so unlucky?!

How can I waste my luck in such a place? How can I fix this!

The quicksand cave was still expanding. He recalled that a sandstorm had passed by here a few days ago. Perhaps it was because of the change in the sand layer that his cannon had caused a chain reaction.

Although he was curious about what Felonia was, it was more important for him to kill Rose Militant.

He left a mark on the coordinate radar and continued to chase.

The two vehicles sped away quickly.

The old pilgrim's hands were trembling. He was excited and called out to his companions behind him.

"That … that must be Felonia. Let's go there quickly!"

The pilgrims were excited. They could not wait and walked towards the cave that was gradually stabilizing.

"Felonia's treasure … Felonia's treasure …" the old pilgrim mumbled to himself as tears streamed down his cheeks. He felt that his years of persistence were finally paying off.

…

After chasing for a few more kilometers, Thorns ran out of ammunition. No matter how fierce the firepower was, it was bound to run out eventually. However, Han Xiao let out a long sigh of relief. This chase was finally coming to an end.

"Those ladies in front should stop now. If they don't stop, they will be too cowardly."

"That guy is finally done shooting!"

Su Li was the creator of Thorns. She immediately noticed that something was wrong with Thorns.

Luo Qing heaved a sigh of relief and shouted, "Turn around!"

The two vehicles were about four hundred meters apart. Han Xiao had already stopped his vehicle. When he saw Rose Militant's off-road vehicle turn around, he smiled and kept shooting with his sniper rifle.

Four hundred meters was enough for him to shoot eight to ten shots.

Four bullets pierced through the bulletproof glass. The fifth bullet was aimed at the driver.

Luo Qing, who was in the passenger seat, raised her hand and blocked the front of the driver. The bullet seemed to have hit an invisible barrier. A ripple of white light appeared in the air. The bullet was flattened by the recoil and turned into a metal cake that floated in the air.

"A Force Field Mutant." Han Xiao squinted his eyes. He felt that this was a tricky situation.

Although there were many strange Mutants, some people could awaken similar Mutants. The Force Field Mutant was a big branch of Mutants. Force Field, Elemental Control, Physique Enhancement, and Transformation were all common Mutants.

The Force Field Mutant was able to control objects from a distance. They could form barriers out of thin air and condense invisible collisions. It was a natural counter to gunners.

With that in mind, Han Xiao immediately stuffed a Hayme bullet into his mouth and fired again. Luo Qing blocked the bullet with her Force Field like before. The bullet was flattened and released a light green poisonous gas. Everyone in the vehicle was poisoned. They felt dizzy, their chests were tight, and their HP dropped continuously.

Han Xiao knew from the battle information that Luo Qing was also at Level 30 like him. Her Force Field Mutant had not reached the stage where she could control gases.

The next bullet was a high-explosive one. It set the interior of the vehicle ablaze. However, it was quickly extinguished by the fire extinguisher. This was a vehicle used for escape. There was a fire extinguisher in the vehicle to prevent accidents.

Han Xiao's plan to force the enemy to abandon the vehicle had failed. However, he was not discouraged. He fired another two Hayme bullets. The Rose Militant's off-road vehicle was surrounded by a thick green poisonous gas. It looked like a plague tank.

After a few shots, the enemy was only a hundred meters away from him.

Han Xiao put away his gun, stepped on the accelerator, and rammed into the off-road vehicle!

Su Li's expression changed slightly. She quickly said, "Get out of the way. Thorns' armor is too thick. We can't ram through it."

The driver heard her and quickly turned the steering wheel. He wanted to brush past Thorns. Han Xiao saw this and turned in the same direction. Unfortunately, he was one step too late. He only brushed past the rear of the off-road vehicle. He wanted to wreck the enemy's off-road vehicle so that he could use Thorns to kite the enemy. However, the Rose Militant reacted in time and dodged his attack.

Luo Qing realized that even though Thorns had run out of ammunition, it was not a toothless tiger. She suppressed her anger and said, "Forget it. Let's not waste time with him."

The off-road vehicle turned around and ran for a few meters. Luo Qing realized that Thorns did not chase after them. She thought that Han Xiao had given up. She heaved a sigh of relief.

She gritted her teeth and said, "I'll let you go this time. When the reinforcements arrive, it will be your time to die!"

Just as she finished her thought, an invisible wave spread out from Thorns. The off-road vehicle suddenly lost its power and slid a few meters. It was paralyzed on the spot, and the people in the vehicle fell onto the ground.

In the backseat of Thorns, Han Xiao activated the electromagnetic pulse interference device. Thorns lost its power as a result.

Han Xiao sighed. This was the last resort to prevent the enemy from escaping. He did not want to use it, but seeing that Luo Qing did not have the guts to stay and beat him up, he could only watch helplessly. Even if Thorns could be repaired, it would take at least ten minutes.

Then, it would be a battle between humans!

"Electromagnetic pulse! The vehicle broke down! " Luo Qing's mind buzzed. She had been tricked time and time again. She could no longer suppress her anger. She got out of the vehicle and charged forward. The force field erupted from her feet. Every step she took allowed her to cross a few meters. She was like a cannonball as she dashed toward Han Xiao. The force field around her flickered.

"Do you want to die so badly?!"
